name: Yogi Bryan
reason: Health rule: his own site (yogibryan.com, read 5 Nov 2026) presents him as a hypnotherapist and NLP trainer who helps people sleep better and rewire their minds, and his YouTube channel ('Sleep Hypnosis & Yoga Nidra', 23.1K) is largely condition-led (anxiety and panic relief, sobriety, weight loss, grief healing hypnosis); his other offers are an app and business mentorship for wellness coaches. Contact route found (booking form, app support inbox), so not parked any more, but too little passes the health rule for a spiritual teacher's page. Judgement call for the owner.
